representations: Functions use a byte string: one JavaScript character with charCode 0..255 per byte. utf8_bytes_fn converts Unicode strings first. Git blob SHA1 uses byte-string header 'blob '+bytes.length+'\0' followed by bytes. Decoders must not be treated as proof without exact expected byte count, SHA256 and Git SHA1 checks.

helper_sources.utf8_bytes_fn: function utf8(s){let o="";for(const c of s){const p=c.codePointAt(0);if(p<128)o+=String.fromCharCode(p);else if(p<2048)o+=String.fromCharCode(192|(p>>>6),128|(p&63));else if(p<65536)o+=String.fromCharCode(224|(p>>>12),128|((p>>>6)&63),128|(p&63));else o+=String.fromCharCode(240|(p>>>18),128|((p>>>12)&63),128|((p>>>6)&63),128|(p&63));}return o;}
helper_sources.sha1_byte_fn: function sha1(s){let x=Array.from(s,c=>c.charCodeAt(0));if(x.some(v=>v>255))throw Error("byte string required");const n=x.length*8;x.push(128);while(x.length%64!==56)x.push(0);for(let i=7;i>=0;i--)x.push(Math.floor(n/2**(i*8))&255);let h=[0x67452301,0xefcdab89,0x98badcfe,0x10325476,0xc3d2e1f0];const R=(v,n)=>(v<<n)|(v>>>(32-n));for(let o=0;o<x.length;o+=64){let w=[];for(let i=0;i<16;i++)w[i]=(x[o+4*i]<<24)|(x[o+4*i+1]<<16)|(x[o+4*i+2]<<8)|x[o+4*i+3];for(let i=16;i<80;i++)w[i]=R(w[i-3]^w[i-8]^w[i-14]^w[i-16],1);let[a,b,c,d,e]=h;for(let i=0;i<80;i++){let f=i<20?(b&c)|(~b&d):i<40?b^c^d:i<60?(b&c)|(b&d)|(c&d):b^c^d;let k=i<20?0x5a827999:i<40?0x6ed9eba1:i<60?0x8f1bbcdc:0xca62c1d6;let t=(R(a,5)+f+e+k+w[i])|0;e=d;d=c;c=R(b,30);b=a;a=t}h=h.map((v,i)=>(v+[a,b,c,d,e][i])|0)}return h.map(v=>(v>>>0).toString(16).padStart(8,"0")).join("")}
helper_sources.base64_decode_bytes_fn: function decode64(s){const abc="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}$/.test(s)||s.length%4)throw Error("b64");let out="",acc=0,bits=0;for(const c of s){if(c==="=")break;acc=(acc<<6)|abc.indexOf(c);bits+=6;if(bits>=8){bits-=8;out+=String.fromCharCode((acc>>bits)&255);}}return out;}
